From [[Brandon Sanderson]]'s [http://brandonsanderson.com/blog/917/The-Great-Hunt-Completed! website]:

Peter here again. Today at around 9:00 p.m. in Venice, Italy, intrepid Wheel of Time fan [http://twitter.com/cuthbert19 Federico] located the final [http://brandonsanderson.com/blog/916/The-Great-Hunt-Update The Great Hunt] code's hiding place . . . and confirmed that the code was no longer there. Maybe someone saw Brandon's friend Ryan place it on top of this photo booth, perhaps via the prominent security camera, but in any case the clue is gone.
